what: Why not a new data lake?
title: Versioned, Lineage-Tracked Data Management for the Physio Ecosystem
text: OmicsLake already provides mature, domain-agnostic core: DuckDB / Apache Arrow / Parquet backend, snapshots time-travel, cross-dataset lineage tracking, dplyr/query layer. adapters, however, written omics object types (SummarizedExperiment, SingleCellExperiment, MultiAssayExperiment, Spectra, XCMS, …) fit physiological-signal objects -. PhysioLake therefore inherits OmicsLake core adds physiology delta: ecosystem-specific adapters utilities, registered OmicsLake’s public register_adapter() extension point. lake engine reimplemented.

title: Versioned, Lineage-Tracked Data Management for the Physio Ecosystem
text: PhysioExperiment SummarizedExperiment subclass extra samplingRate slot; provenance, events, derived estimates live metadata(). OmicsLake’s generic SEAdapter round-trips assays / colData / rowData / metadata reconstructs plain SummarizedExperiment, dropping class identity sampling rate. PhysioExperimentAdapter inherits restores exactly — round trip preserves class, sampling rate, every assay bit-identically, W3C-PROV provenance (verified: provenanceHash() identical ). ecosystem’s per-object (micro) provenance thus lands intact alongside lake’s cross-dataset (macro) lineage.

title: Versioned, Lineage-Tracked Data Management for the Physio Ecosystem
code: library(PhysioLake)   # registers the Physio adapters with OmicsLake on load  pe   <- some_PhysioExperiment            # e.g. after butterworthFilter() lake <- OmicsLake::Lake$new("study")  lake$put("eeg", pe)                       # stored with full fidelity pe2  <- lake$get("eeg")                   # a PhysioExperiment again identical(PhysioCore::provenanceHash(pe2),           PhysioCore::provenanceHash(pe))  # TRUE  lake$snap("v1.0")                         # snapshot / time-travel lake$tree("eeg")                          # dataset lineage

title: PhysioExperiment adapter for OmicsLake — PhysioExperimentAdapter
text: OmicsLake::LakeAdapter stores retrieves PhysioCore::PhysioExperiment objects OmicsLake full fidelity. PhysioExperiment SummarizedExperiment subclass one extra slot (samplingRate); provenance, events, derived estimates live metadata(). OmicsLake's generic SEAdapter already round-trips assays, colData, rowData, metadata, reconstructs plain SummarizedExperiment – losing class identity sampling rate. adapter inherits SEAdapter adds missing piece: stashes sampling rate metadata put() rebuilds PhysioExperiment get(). provenance carried metadata(), survives round trip unchanged (verified: provenanceHash() identical ), ecosystem's per-object (micro) W3C-PROV provenance lands intact next OmicsLake's cross-dataset (macro) lineage. Assays 2-D matrices (e.g. epoched time x channel x trial arrays), generic SEAdapter collapse storing flat tables, likewise stashed metadata spliced back original order get(). higher priority() generic SEAdapter ensures adapter selected PhysioExperiment objects (also satisfy SEAdapter).

title: PhysioLake 0.1.0
text: Initial draft. Integrates ecosystem OmicsLake inheriting domain-agnostic core (DuckDB/Arrow/Parquet backend, snapshots/time-travel, cross-dataset lineage, query layer) registering physiology-specific adapter OmicsLake’s register_adapter() extension point. PhysioExperimentAdapter (inherits OmicsLake::SEAdapter) stores retrieves PhysioExperiment objects full fidelity: preserves class identity samplingRate slot generic SummarizedExperiment adapter drop, — provenance rides metadata() — W3C-PROV provenance survives round trip unchanged (provenanceHash() identical ). Registered load via .onLoad; re-runnable registerPhysioAdapters(). Verified non-SummarizedExperiment physio types (MultiRatePhysioExperiment, PhysioLongitudinal, AnalysisResult) round-trip lake full fidelity via OmicsLake’s default object serialization — including nested PhysioExperiment provenance — bespoke storage adapters needed (pinned test-containers.R). physioPut() / physioProvenance(): provenance bridge stores object’s W3C-PROV op-DAG (PhysioCore::provenance()) queryable companion table records lineage dependency (put(..., depends_on=)), per-object (micro) provenance becomes first-class node OmicsLake’s cross-dataset (macro) lineage – lake$tree() / deps() / impact() see . physioPutBundle(): store reproducibility-substrate / PhysioAgent run bundle (frozen prereg, run manifest, op-DAG, terminal artifact, claims, …) individual lake entries wired internal lineage edges (stored parents-first topological order), whole run becomes versioned, lineage-tracked lake object queryable via tree() / deps(). Gives substrate persistent store lacks (content-addresses runs persist ).
